graders.name: 03-finding-cites-contradicted-source-point
graders.evidence:
## Verdict
- changes required
- Blocking findings: 3

## Findings
- P1
  - Category: conflict
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location (relative path, section or line): fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 2 "Scope", lines 15–17
  - Evidence (the source point or the document sentence it contradicts): fixtures/source-notes.md point 4 states the coordinator role's existing case "was left untouched — no new case was added for it in this batch, and it does not pair a planted defect with a control section the way the three new cases do." The PRD states "This batch adds one seeded-defect eval case for each of the four reviewer roles — code, security, document and coordinator — pairing each planted defect with a correct control section in the same fixture," directly contradicting the source.
  - Suggestion (the concrete sentence or criterion the author should write): "This batch adds one seeded-defect eval case for each of three reviewer roles — code, security and document — pairing each planted defect with a correct control section in the same fixture. The coordinator role's existing case is unchanged and out of scope for this batch."

- P2
  - Category: conflict
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location (relative path, section or line): fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 3 "Acceptance criteria", AC-01 and AC-02, lines 24–27
  - Evidence (the source point or the document sentence it contradicts): AC-01 and AC-02 both require "each of the four cases" (by cross-reference to section 2's four roles, including coordinator) to have a positive/negative grader tied to a planted defect and control section. fixtures/source-notes.md point 4 confirms no such fourth case exists, so no grader can be observed passing for a coordinator case under this criterion.
  - Suggestion (the concrete sentence or criterion the author should write): "AC-01 Each of the three new cases (code, security, document) has a positive grader that detects the planted defect. AC-02 Each of the three new cases has a negative grader confirming its control section is not wrongly flagged."

- P3
  - Category: conflict
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location (relative path, section or line): fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 2 "Scope", lines 18–20
  - Evidence (the source point or the document sentence it contradicts): fixtures/source-notes.md point 6 states the scaffold script is "invoked only when the runner is passed `--scaffold`" — copying is conditional. The PRD states "Each case's fixtures are copied into the run workspace before the run by the case's own scaffold script," with no mention of the `--scaffold` condition, implying unconditional/automatic invocation.
  - Suggestion (the concrete sentence or criterion the author should write): "Each case's fixtures are copied into the run workspace by the case's own scaffold.sh, invoked only when the runner is passed --scaffold, so no case depends on a shared fixture directory."

## Not raised
- Source points 1–3 (new cases for code, security and document reviewer roles) are correctly carried into the PRD's scope statement, aside from the four-vs-three count error already flagged in P1.
- Source point 5 (each of the three new cases pairs a planted defect with a correct control section in the same fixture) is correctly reflected in scope, independent of the coordinator overclaim.
- The Goal section accurately reflects the source's intent to add seeded-defect eval coverage for the reviewer roles.
- The References section correctly cites source-notes.md as the source document.
- The document's field table (Status, Owner, Created/updated) and identifier usage (AC-01, AC-02) show no duplication or organization issues.

## Evidence
- Files read: fixtures/source-notes.md, fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md.
- No previous review report found at fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md.review.md; treated as round 1.
- No `.harness/project.yaml` was consulted for language; report written in English per default.

graders.evidence:
## Verdict
- changes required
- Blocking findings: 3

## Findings
- P1
  - Category: conflict
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location: fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 2 (Scope), first bullet
  - Evidence: The document states "This batch adds one seeded-defect eval case for each of the four reviewer roles — code, security, document and coordinator — pairing each planted defect with a correct control section in the same fixture." This contradicts fixtures/source-notes.md point 4: "The `coordinator` role's existing case ... was left untouched — no new case was added for it in this batch, and it does not pair a planted defect with a control section the way the three new cases do."
  - Suggestion: Rewrite the bullet to "This batch adds one seeded-defect eval case for each of three reviewer roles — code, security and document — pairing each planted defect with a correct control section in the same fixture. The coordinator role's existing case is left unchanged and is out of scope for this batch."

- P2
  - Category: conflict
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location: fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 3 (Acceptance criteria), AC-01 and AC-02
  - Evidence: Both criteria say "Each of the four cases," inheriting the same overclaim addressed in P1. Per source-notes.md point 4, the coordinator role has no new case and no control-section pairing, so a grader requirement for a fourth, coordinator-paired case is not supported by the source.
  - Suggestion: Change "each of the four cases" to "each of the three new cases (code, security, document)" in both AC-01 and AC-02.

- P3
  - Category: gap
  - Severity: blocking
  - Location: fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md, section 2 (Scope), second bullet
  - Evidence: The document states fixtures "are copied into the run workspace before the run by the case's own scaffold script," omitting the condition in source-notes.md point 6: "invoked only when the runner is passed `--scaffold`." As written, a builder would wire the scaffold to run automatically on every run, not only when `--scaffold` is passed.
  - Suggestion: "Each case's fixtures are copied into the run workspace by the case's own scaffold.sh, invoked only when the runner is passed `--scaffold`; no case depends on a shared fixture directory."

## Not raised
- Scope bullet 1's coverage of the code, security and document reviewer roles matches source-notes.md points 1–3.
- The pairing of planted defect with a correct control section for the three new cases (source point 5) is correctly captured for code, security and document.
- AC-01 and AC-02 are each independently observable (pass/fail on grader presence and behavior) once the "four cases" count is corrected — no subjective language found.
- No duplicate identifiers: AC-01/AC-02 are unique and sequential.
- No excess requirements found beyond what source-notes.md supports.
- References section correctly cites source-notes.md.

## Evidence
- Read fixtures/source-notes.md (6 points) and fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.md (sections 1–4) in full before recording findings.
- No previous review report exists at fixtures/PRD-scope-claim.review.md; treated as round 1.
